How do I get my Timeline file?
On your phone (recommended) — Google now keeps Timeline on your device:
Android: Settings → Location → Location services → Timeline → Export Timeline data.
Or in the Google Maps app: profile picture → Your Timeline → ⋯ → Location & privacy settings → Export Timeline data. You’ll get Timeline.json — send it to this device and drop it above.

Google Takeout (older cloud data): takeout.google.com → deselect all → Location History (Timeline) → Export. The file is Records.json inside the zip.

Menus move around between app versions — the words to look for are “Export Timeline data”. Any filename works; files are recognized by their contents.
Your location file never leaves this device — everything runs inside this browser tab.
Siren data: tzevaadom.co.il public archive, embedded whole into this file (Oct 7, 2023 → Jul 20, 2026). Nothing is fetched — it runs with zero internet.
